description: Maps Shops.json SalableItemTags to item categories or specific item IDs. Used to auto-derive which shops buy which items from players.
notes: Standard category_* tags map to numeric item categories from Objects.json.
The three 'sell_at_*' special tags are game-engine aliases for the same categories as the explicit tags.
They appear redundant but the game uses them for legacy/dynamic resolution. We treat them as aliases.
category_ingredients refers to 4 specific cooking ingredient items not in any numbered category.
book_item is a context tag on item objects (not a category number).
category_weapon/boots/ring/trinket refer to items from separate game files (not Objects.json).
